newsitem.title: FRANCE: Credit Lyonnais sees strong profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais sees strong profit rise.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais expects a strong rise in its 1997 net profit, chairman Jean Peyrelevade told a news conference on Thursday.
"I cannot say to you how much the net result will improve, but it seems clear that it will be expressed not in hundreds of millions but in billions (of francs)," he said.

"We are rather optimistic about an improvement in our pre-tax, pre-exceptional result in 1997," Peyrelevade said, adding he expected "modest growth" in banking income, a firm hand on general expenses and lower risk costs compared to 1996.
To that will be added the effects of the 1996 restructuring.
He said that the first two months of the year had been according to plan.
